owner_decision: 8 Oct 2026: 180 days, at least 5 finished groups and 200 cut PCS, product+size then the same model, one-sided Wilson 90% lower bound floored to 0.1%; never across models, never 100%; insufficient data uses the reviewed estimate A or UNKNOWN; stored as a versioned policy and tested before activation
scope: The policy is saved by an OWNER or ADMIN with master.product.manage and a reason (actor, role and time recorded; revisions immutable; the confidence, method, rounding and level order are fixed). Without a saved policy the plan preflight keeps the earlier pending answer byte for byte. Only cutting groups whose stored PL-8 exhaustion proof matches their current facts under the current kernel count; a cancelled, corrected or backdated row removes a group until it is proven again. Finish date = the last physical event of the group, window in WIB calendar days. Plan v1 and v2 previews and apply read the history in their own transaction.
client: Kebijakan yield histori panel under Data permintaan & stok: the owner-approved package shown and prefilled, saved as a version with a reason, the same request repeated after a lost reply; plan preview states the history (lower bound, groups, PCS, level, policy version) or why there is none, the Wilson bound checked exactly in the browser.
browser: Desktop and mobile: open the policy panel from Data permintaan & stok, see the package prefilled and not in force, save it, see version 1 active with role and time; no horizontal scroll.
synthetic: Labelled SYNTHETIC clones only in PL5H_NEVER_CROSS_MODEL (one re-pointed order) and PL5H_LIMIT_200_UNDER_8S (199 + 1 clones of a finished group); every other group is cut, picked up, sewn, washed, QC-ed and scrapped through ordinary writers.
